title: Understanding Substance Abuse
objectives: Define substance abuse and distinguish between use, misuse, and abuse
Identify common substances of abuse in Zimbabwe
Explain short-term and long-term effects on health

activities.activity: Warm-up: Ask 'What do you know about drugs?' — write responses on board
Mini-lecture: Types of substances and how they affect the brain
Group work: Sort Myth-Fact cards into true and false
Discussion: Why do people start using substances?
Reflection: Students write one thing they learned

title: Peer Pressure Skills
objectives: Recognise different forms of peer pressure
Develop personal strategies for resisting pressure

activities.activity: Scenario reading: Students read aloud different peer pressure situations
Role-play: Practice saying NO in pairs using the STOP technique
Strategy building: Create personal refusal scripts
Journal reflection: Write about a time you faced pressure

title: My Mental Health Matters
objectives: Identify signs of mental health challenges

activities.activity: Check-in: How are you feeling right now? Point to the chart
Video or story: A young person's mental health journey
Discussion: What affects mental health? Brainstorm factors
Resource mapping: Where can you get help in your area?

title: Building Healthy Habits
objectives: Identify one positive habit to build

activities.activity: Discussion: What's one habit you do every day without thinking?
Teach the habit loop: Cue → Routine → Reward
Activity: Map your own habits using the habit loop
Planning: Create a 7-day plan for one new positive habit
